paite: Huan amelma tengteng khut a pan leh Saul khut a pan TOUPA'N ahutkhiak ni in David in hiai la thu TOUPA kiang ah agen hi.
heading: David Vualzohna La / (Sam 18)

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA tuh ka suangpi leh ka kulhpi leh hon humbitpa ahi.
Ka suangpi Pathian, amah ka muang ding a; ka phaw leh ka hotdamna kii, ka insang leh ka bukna ahi. Ka hondampa, hiamgamna a pan na hon hondam hi.
Phat tak TOUPA ka sam ding a; huchi in hon doute lak a pan hotdam in ka om ding hi.
"Sihna tuikihot in hon umkimvel a, Pathian limsak lou mite tui lian in ahon lausak hi.
Sheol khauhualte'n hon gaksuak a; sihna thangte'n hon awksak uh.
Ka lungzin in TOUPA ka sam a, ahi, ka Pathian ka sam hi: A tempul a pan ka aw aza a, ka kikou husa abil ah alut hi.
"Huaitak in lei aling a, akisat hi. Aheh ziak in van kingaknate nangawn kisat in alingta uhi.
Anak a pan meikhu azamtou a, akam a kipan katmang hat meikuang apawt hat a, huai in meihol akuangsak hi.
Ama'n vante akunsak a, ahong suk ua; akhenuai ah mialna a-om hi.
"Cherub tung ah atuang a, alengta hi, huih khate tung ah amah muh in a-om hi.
Khomial in aki-umkimvel a, tui vomte, van meipi sah miuhmeuhte abawl hi.
Ama a vakna tawn in meiholte akuang hi.
"TOUPA van a pan ahong ging a, Tungnungpen in a-aw asuaksak hi.
Thaltangte akapkhia a, amau adalhzaksak a; khua aphesak a, abuaizaksak hi.
TOUPA salhna, anakvangte a hu in tuipi lampite ahong kilang a, lei kingaknate hihlat in a- omta hi.
"Ama'n tunglam a pan hon sawksuk a, ahon len a; tuipi a pan hon kaikheta hi.
Kei hon dou hattak a pan hon humbit a, kei hon hote a pan leng; kei a ding in lah ahat lo ngal ua.
Ka tuahsiat ni in ahon sual ua, himahleh TOUPA ka kingakna ahi.
Ama'n mun awngthawltak ah hon pikhia a; ka tung a akipah ziak in hon humbitta hi.
"TOUPA'N ka diktatna dungzui in ka tung ah ahih a; ka khutte sianthoudan dungzui in hon thuk hi.
TOUPA lampite ka zui a, ka Pathian a pan giloutak in ka paimang ngei ngal kei a!
Avaihawmna tengteng ka ma a a-om ziak in: adan thusehte ka kilehheisan ngei kei hi.
Ama ah leng gensiatbei ka hi lai a, ka thulimlouhna a pan ka kihuikhia hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N ka diktatdan bang zel in hon na thukta a; amitmuh a ka sianthoudan bang zel in.
"Chingtheite kiang ah chingthei in na kilang ding a, mihoihkimte kiang ah hoihkim in na kilang ding hi.
Misiangthoute kiang ah siangthou in na kilang ding a; migenhakte kiang ah genhak in akilang ding.
Haksa thuak mite na hondam ding a; mikisatheite na niamsak theihna ding in atung uah na mit atu gige hi.
"TOUPA aw, ka khawnvak na hi ngal a. TOUPA'N ka mialna avaksak ding.
Nang panpih in sepaihhon toh ka tai a, ka Pathian panpih mah in kulh ka tawmkan hi.
"Pathian lampi ahoihkim a; TOUPA thu etchetsa ahi; amah muangte tengteng a ding in amah lum ahi.
TOUPA lou kua Pathian a-om a? I Pathian lou kua suangpi a-om a?
Pathian ka hatna leh thilhihtheihna ahi a, Ama'n ka lampite hoihkim in abawl hi.
Ka khepekte zukpi khepek bang in abawl a; ka mun sangte ah hon omsak zel hi.
Ka khutte galdou ding in asinsak a; huchi in ka bante'n dal thalpeu atansak hi.
"Nang na hotdamna lum na hon pia a; na nunnemna in na hon bawl lianta hi.
Ka nuai a ka kalsuante na liansak a, huchi in ka khete atolh kei uhi.
Hon doute ka delhpha a, ka hihmang a; hihmanthat sipsip a a-om masiah uh ka nungkik kei hi.
Athohnawn theihlouhna ding un ka hihmang sipsip a, ka satzan ngiingei a; ahi, ka khenuai ah apukta uh.
Nang galdou ding in hatna in na hon gak a; hon sual mite ka nuai ah na nuaisiahta hi.
Hon hote ka hihmanthat theihna ding in, kei hon doute ngawng na hon pia hi.
Amaute adak kimvel ua, himahleh hondam ding kuamah a-om kei uh. TOUPA a-en ua, himahleh adawng kei.
Huaitak in ke'n lei a leivui bang in ka khennel dimdem a, kholak buannawi bang mai in ka tuanzak a, ka thehzak vekta hi.
"Nang ka mite kisualna a pan leng na hon humbit a; namte lutang hi ding in na hon kemhoih hi. Ka theih ngei louh nam in ka nna asemta ding.
Ka kiang ah namdangte ahong kipe ding ua; ka tanchin azaktak un ka thu azui ding uh.
Namdangte atulmang ding ua, a-insang ua kipan ling kawm in ahong paisuk ding uh.
"TOUPA ahing hi. Ka suangpi phat in om henla; ka hotdamna suangpi Pathian tawisang in om hen:
Phu hon laksakpa leh ka nuai a mite koihpa Pathian;
Hon doute a pan hon domtoupa: Kei hon doute tunglam ah na hon domkang a, hiamgammi lak a pan na hon humbit hi.
"Huaiziak in aw TOUPA, namte lak ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a, na min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
Akumpipa a dia amah hotdamna insang ahi a, athaunilh, David leh asuante tung ah tangtawn in hehpihna alangsak,” achi hi.
